fact: FAO with NISR, RAB, the National Land Authority and the Rwanda Space Agency developed a first national land cover prototype from earth observation (75% accuracy), with a national field survey planned for December 2023-January 2024 and crop type mapping and yield activities in 2024.
title: Bridging Agricultural Data Gaps: Innovations in Geospatial and Non-Conventional Data Sources
publisher: FAO, African Commission on Agricultural Statistics, 28th Session
